references.text: Describes a foolish people who mock the Lord's name, parallel to 'a foolish and unwise people'
God is called 'our Father' and the one who redeemed Israel, parallel to God as father and creator
The Lord is called 'our Father' and 'the one who formed us', same theme of God as creator and father
God as father who deserves honor, parallel to the father-child relationship between God and Israel
The question of God as common father and creator of Israel
The Lord who has 'bought' or 'acquired' his people; the same verb 'qanah' is used
The Lord has created us and we belong to him, parallel to God as creator
God has bought the believers, parallel to the Lord having 'bought' his people
God's people are his treasured possession whom he has saved, parallel to God as owner and creator of his people
